name: fix_insecure_cors_config
description: Fixes an insecure CORS config that combines a wildcard origin with credentials
prompts: In this Maven Spring Boot project, the `reports()` method in src/main/java/com/optarena/reports/ReportsController.java is annotated `@CrossOrigin(origins = "*", allowCredentials = "true")`. This is an insecure CORS configuration: combining a wildcard origin with allowCredentials=true would let any website read this endpoint's response while sending the user's credentials. Fix the @CrossOrigin annotation on `reports()` so that `origins` is restricted to a specific, non-empty allow-list of real origins (for example `{"https://app.example.com"}`) instead of "*", while keeping `allowCredentials = "true"` since legitimate authenticated cross-origin calls from that allow-listed origin must still work. Keep the annotation on the `reports()` method and do not remove the /reports endpoint.
